step1.title: 1️⃣ Register PDF Materials
step1.catalog: Download from recommended free material sites

step2.title: 2️⃣ Configure SNS Access Permissions
step2.line2: Set SNS usage time limit (5-60 minutes)
step2.line3: SNS links become active for the set duration after grading

step3.title: 3️⃣ Study with PDF
step3.line3: Write directly with finger or Apple Pencil
step3.line4: Pinch to zoom, 2-finger drag to pan

step4.title: 4️⃣ AI Grading
step4.line2: Drag to select the area to grade
step4.line4: AI automatically grades and provides feedback
step4.warning: ⚠️ AI grading is not 100% accurate. Parents must verify.

step1.title: 1️⃣ Add a Reference PDF
step1.catalog: Import a reference PDF you found on the web
step1.local: Add a PDF saved on your device

step2.title: 2️⃣ Choose Your AI Teacher
step2.line2: Enable the teacher levels you want to use
step2.line3: Choose which teacher appears by default

step3.title: 3️⃣ Copy While Looking at the Reference
step3.line1: Open a PDF to see the reference on side A and a blank canvas on side B
step3.line3: Draw freely on side B with your finger or Apple Pencil
step3.line4: Pinch each side to zoom, and drag with two fingers to pan

step4.title: 4️⃣ Ask the AI Teacher
step4.line1Tap: to choose a teacher and start the review
step4.line2: First, position and zoom sides A and B so they are easy to compare
step4.line3: The currently visible A and B views are sent to the AI as they appear
step4.line4: The AI compares the mood and shapes, then shares strengths and a next practice point
step4.warning: ⚠️ AI advice is a reference, not a final judgment of the value of your artwork.

step5.title: 5️⃣ Review Your Work
step5.history: Progress - Review artwork, advice, and improvement over time
step5.delete: Trash icon - Delete a reference PDF

Download the PDF and print it out for a great workbook experience!

drawingCatalog.title: 🎨 Recommended Free Drawing Materials
drawingCatalog.description:
Download a PDF you want to practice from one of these sites,
then add it to CopiCopi with the import button at the bottom right of the home screen.
drawingCatalog.tipsContent:
Start with a simple step-by-step worksheet.
Even when the reference and practice space share one PDF page, CopiCopi lets you view it on side A and copy it onto a blank side B.
drawingCatalog.disclaimer:
※ Follow each site's terms of use.
CopiCopi does not redistribute these materials and only links to their official pages.
